look_here_first: Recognize compact round clusters of narrow gray-green, recurved straplike leaves perched on branches or wires; examine individual leaf scales and small flowers when present.
photo_note: One permanent, attributed photo installed for initial visual recognition. Additional anatomy/identity review is necessary; this batch does not determine regional nativity.
identification_caution: Epiphyte is not a parasitic plant. Growing on a tree branch does not by itself show the tree is unhealthy.
